scope: Synthetic PAD Excel range-read probe in a dedicated flow; current seven-file bundle was not changed and no existing business workbook was used.

run_observation.interpretation: The PAD UI showed a populated 6-by-3 ExcelData preview after the bounded run wait; the helper's completion acknowledgement was not observed, so this is not a full run-helper PASS.

result: Excel range reading from a synthetic workbook was observed with a stable 6-row, 3-column preview and no PAD error. This proves range-read setup and preview only; Excel row iteration, per-row side effects, and cell-reference extraction remain unconfirmed.
